component.name: Nausicaa
component.summary: Play your videos, and nothing else
Regarder vos vidéos, et rien d'autre
Ihre Videos abspielen, und sonst nichts

description.p: Nausicaa is a small video player for GNOME, built on the mpv engine. A simple window, the mouse habits of VLC, and a play queue that remembers where you stopped. It follows the desktop theme.

Nausicaa est un petit lecteur vidéo pour GNOME, sur le moteur mpv. Une fenêtre simple, les gestes de souris de VLC, et une file de lecture qui se souvient où l'on s'était arrêté. Il suit le thème du bureau.

Nausicaa ist ein kleiner Videoplayer für GNOME auf Basis von mpv. Ein schlichtes Fenster, die Mausgesten von VLC und eine Wiedergabeliste, die sich merkt, wo man aufgehört hat. Es folgt dem Thema der Arbeitsumgebung.

ul.li: Click to pause, double-click for full screen without pausing, mouse wheel for the volume with an on-screen display
Pause when the window is minimised, resume when it comes back
Each video resumes where you left it
Open one episode: the following ones are queued, in natural order
Play queue with shuffle, repeat and drag to reorder, saved as a playlist
Audio tracks, subtitles, speed, frame by frame, picture capture
Clic pour la pause, double-clic pour le plein écran sans pause, molette pour le volume affiché sur l'image
Pause quand la fenêtre est réduite, reprise quand elle revient
Chaque vidéo reprend où on l'avait laissée
Un épisode ouvert : les suivants rejoignent la file, dans l'ordre des noms
File de lecture : aléatoire, répétition, glisser pour réordonner, enregistrée en liste de lecture
Pistes audio, sous-titres, vitesse, image par image, capture de l'image
Klick pausiert, Doppelklick schaltet ohne Pause in den Vollbildmodus, Mausrad regelt die Lautstärke mit Einblendung
Pause beim Minimieren, weiter, wenn das Fenster zurückkommt
Jedes Video wird dort fortgesetzt, wo man aufgehört hat
Eine Folge öffnen: die nächsten kommen in die Wiedergabeliste, in natürlicher Reihenfolge
Wiedergabeliste mit Zufall, Wiederholung und Umsortieren per Ziehen, als Datei speicherbar
Tonspuren, Untertitel, Geschwindigkeit, Einzelbilder, Bildschirmfoto
German: the play queue is now called “Wiedergabeliste”, like in VLC and Celluloid (suggested by a user)
The keyboard shortcuts window fits on a single page (no more GTK warnings in the terminal)
The keyboard shortcuts window now lists its own shortcut (F1 or Ctrl+?)
The play queue can open on the left or on the right of the window (Preferences → Appearance)
Keyboard shortcuts window: F1 (shown in the menu) and Ctrl+? now work whatever the keyboard layout (German QWERTZ reported)

Picture in picture (Ctrl+P): a borderless 16:9 window, always on top, in the bottom-right corner of the screen (X11); controls and a way back appear when the mouse passes over it; drag it to move it, drag its edges to resize it; its size and place are remembered
The choice between total length and time left is remembered
Welcome page and audio-only page show your theme's window background (translucent themes included), like Ithaca
Sound: Nausicaa's volume is now the only one that counts — its stream volume in the sound settings is set back to 100 %, so 75 % in Nausicaa sounds like 75 % in VLC
The sound stream is named “Nausicaa” in the volume control (it was “mpv”)
Full screen: the controls and the volume display are translucent, the picture shows through
Full screen: the controls and the volume display are tinted with your theme's view colour over the window background, like file properties; the header bar keeps your theme's style
Full screen: the controls and the volume display take the colours of your theme (window background, accent colour for the bars), like in a window
System controls (MPRIS): GNOME media panel, keyboard media keys and Bluetooth headset buttons (double-tap to pause, earbuds taken off pause the video)
No more “Cannot load libcuda.so.1” message on computers without an NVIDIA card
Full screen: compact, centred, rounded controls floating over the picture, like Celluloid or VLC
First release: a small video player on mpv, for Ubuntu 24.04 / Zorin OS 18 without Flatpak
Click to pause, double-click for full screen without pausing, wheel volume with an on-screen display
Pause when minimised, resume position for each video, following episodes queued
Play queue and playlists, audio tracks, subtitles, speed, picture capture
